hooks.command: jq -n --arg local "$(date '+%A, %B %-d, %Y at %-I:%M %p %Z')" --arg utc "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC')" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:("Current date and time: " + $local + " (" + $utc + "). This is re-injected on every user message — always prefer it over any earlier date stated in this conversation, which may be stale if the conversation spans multiple days.")}}'
